title: Europe’s Far Right, Once Marginal, Now Sets Tone on Spain Migrant Crisis
summary_full: Europe sheltered many refugees in 2015. Its hard-line reaction to a new crisis in Ceuta shows how, 11 years on, the far right has reshaped European attitudes.
